summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage ships install-time dropper that runs obfuscated 728KB payload under downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmods 0o755 the `bun` binary, then invokes it against a shipped sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated blob using string-array + rotation obfuscation (rotator `WV8StW`, encoded-charset decoder `hc1jfK9`, hex-scrambled identifiers) — not readable code. Executing the payload under an alien runtime rather than Node evades tooling that only traces Node-resolved code. The package name and description present it as a fork of `@verdaccio/local-storage`, a typosquat cover story that funnels developers seeking the official Verdaccio storage plugin into installing the dropper. On any `npm install` of this package the obfuscated payload runs automatically with the installing user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
